findings.evidence: The conclusions at lines 65, 109, and 120 explicitly use `Pi.basisFun`; `rg 'standardBasis'` finds only the two introduced theorem names, while Mathlib precedent includes `LinearMap.BilinForm.toMatrix_basisFun` and `Matrix.toLinearMap₂_basisFun`. The naming guide requires name components to correspond to definition names.
findings.fix: Rename them using `basisFun`, e.g. `standardCoact_apply_basisFun`, `coefficientMatrix_basisFun`, and `coordinateBialgHom_basisFun`, updating internal uses.
findings.issue: `standardCoact_basis`, `coefficientMatrix_standardBasis` (line 107), and `coordinateBialgHom_standardBasis` (line 118) obscure that every statement specifically uses `Pi.basisFun`; no `standardBasis` declaration exists.

summary: The three basis-specific theorem names use the nonexistent/ambiguous term `standardBasis` or `basis` instead of Mathlib’s actual `Pi.basisFun` terminology.
